note: exploration after stage 1 on the development folds (evaluation 2023 and 2024), no refit; choices made here are a selection on these folds, and a final check needs its own pre-registration; calibration and holdout were not read
policy: rolling list with release, at most K open (window = horizon)
chronic: the pair had an event (counted as the static list) in [t - D, t)

variants.list node 365d: count over 365 days on the co-failure node of the unit (v4 snapshots)
variants.list+persistence: mean of the within-day ranks of the list and persistence

variant_history: events of 2021 excluded (outside the project's training data); the flat 365-day list of 2023/2024 never reaches 2021; the 730-day window of 2023 cards therefore covers 2022 and part of 2023 only
nodes: v4 monthly snapshots (co-failure groups from > 2 s starts before the month, rule min_joint 3, min_ratio 0.8)
